_comment: The supervisor is the conversational layer, deliberately NOT in agents.json: no worker role may be assigned to it and it must not appear in the role agent picker. `agent` and `model` are what the UI's Team tab edits.
_session_note: Every supported CLI can continue a conversation, but only Claude lets us choose the id up front. For antigravity and opencode the id is captured from the first run's output and stored on the thread.

claude.resume: --resume <id>, with --session-id <uuid> chosen by us on the first turn

antigravity.resume: --conversation <id>, captured from conversation_id in the first run's JSON
antigravity.permission_flag: --mode plan (read-only; agy has no allowlist equivalent)

opencode.resume: --session <id>, captured from sessionID in the first run's JSONL
opencode.permission_flag: no allowlist available -- confined by --agent plan
